summary.name: Viggle
summary.one_liner: Viggle is a spatial generative AI platform for creating and controlling character motion in video scenes, offering a Meme Maker, games, and an API.
use_cases: Making memes by swapping a character into trending clips
Animating a photo of a person into a dance or motion video
Building character swapping or motion capture into an app or game
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Viggle as a Spatial GenAI platform for creating and controlling motion in any scene. The Meme Maker lets users swap characters into moments and remix trending clips into shareable videos. JST-2 (Joint space and time, gen 2.0) is described as a physics-native world model that generates characters, motion and 3D scenes. The Viggle API shows an example workflow: create a character from a photo URL, then start a render with a character ID and a template ID, which returns a video URL. The page also lists brand case studies, including a Coke Studio music video feature and a ZEPETO collaboration.
notable: Character swapping and motion control via a physics-native world model (JST-2)
Public API for character creation, motion capture and renders
Meme Maker for remixing trending clips with any character
caveats: Page does not state specific pricing tiers; the 'Try for free' label suggests a free entry point but paid levels are not described
API details beyond the example request are not specified on the page
